meta.name: add-emacs
meta.description: Add Emacs as a channel. Opens an interactive chat buffer and org-mode integration so you can talk to NanoClaw from within Emacs (Doom, Spacemacs, or vanilla). Local HTTP bridge — no bot token or external service needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 Emacs 直连 AI 助手,对话无需离开编辑器
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果离不开 Emacs,想在编辑器里随时向 AI 提问。
copy.tagline_en: Chat with your AI assistant right inside Emacs without switching tools
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you live in Emacs and want AI help without leaving your editor.

howto.what: 装上后,Emacs 里会多出一个聊天 buffer,你可以直接在 Emacs 内和 Claude 对话;回复几秒内出现,在 org 文件里则以子标题形式落在原处。它走本地 HTTP 桥接,不需要 bot token 或外部服务。
howto.when: 当你用快捷键打开聊天 buffer(C-c n c、SPC N c 等),或对某个标题、选中区域执行 nanoclaw-org-send 时,它就会接管。

say.text: 解释一下光标所在的这个函数
say.note: 在聊天 buffer 里发送后几秒内出现回复

say.text: 帮我审查选中的这段代码
say.note: 回复以子标题形式落在 org 文件里

say.note: 摘要以子节点形式返回

howto.what_en: After installing, Emacs gains a chat buffer so you can talk to Claude without leaving the editor; replies appear in seconds, or as a child heading in your org file. It runs over a local HTTP bridge, no bot token or external service.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you open the chat buffer with your keybinding (C-c n c, SPC N c, etc.) or run nanoclaw-org-send on a heading or selected region.

say_en.note: Reply shows up in the chat buffer in seconds

say_en.text: Review the code I just selected
say_en.note: Reply lands as a child heading in your org file

say_en.text: Turn this agenda entry into action items
say_en.note: Summary returns as a child node
